company_profile.description:
SignalTender is an autonomous Government Contracting (GovCon) and State/Local/Education (SLED) IT & Cybersecurity procurement intelligence platform and developer API ecosystem.

Legacy GovCon bid aggregators charge $15,000+ per year for noisy keyword dumps filled with commodity office supplies, hardware part replacements, and maintenance renewals—leaving lean capture teams to spend 40+ hours manually shredding 150-page PDFs.

SignalTender's 3-layer AI quality control engine monitors Federal (SAM.gov), municipal, and major State SLED procurement portals every 6 hours, stripping 99.4% of commodity noise and delivering actionable B2B software, cloud, data, and cybersecurity solicitations.

WHAT SIGNALTENDER DELIVERS:
• SignalWire Pro ($99/mo): Real-time 6-hour Federal & State SLED IT/Cyber RFP alerts routed directly to Discord, Slack, Microsoft Teams, or custom CRM webhooks.
• CaptureDesk Autopilot ($399/mo): Pre-computed AI capture dossiers on every solicitation—including Shipley Section L/M Compliance Matrices, Bid/No-Bid Pwin (0-100) capability scoring, FAR/DFARS & CMMC 2.0 flow-down redlines, 13 CFR § 125.6 (50% Rule) small-business workshare plans, IGCE wrap-rate & Price-to-Win models, CPARS Volume III past performance citations, SF-30 amendment diffs, NIST 800-53 RMF / Continuous ATO (cATO) packages, FAR 15.102 Oral Presentation murder-board prep, FAR 15.506 Post-Award Debriefing & GAO Bid-Protest analysis, and GSA MAS Schedule SIN mapping.
• Proposal Autopilot Enterprise ($1,499/mo): 1-Click Complete 3-Volume Shipley Proposal .ZIP Compiler (editable Word .docx Volume I Technical + live-formula Excel .xlsx Volume II Cost/CLIN Model + Word .docx Volume III CPARS & 13 CFR § 125.6 Workshare in 90 seconds) and Verified Teaming Clearinghouse.
• Enterprise OEM & FOIA Winning-Bid Vault ($2,499/mo): Post-Award FOIA / State PIA Incumbent Winning LCAT Labor Rate Vault + 50,000 REST & Model Context Protocol (MCP) API calls/mo (@signaltender/mcp-server) for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and internal AI capture stacks.

100% self-serve. Zero annual lock-ins or sales calls. Explore live open IT/Cyber RFPs and test the interactive API playground at https://signaltender.net
